meta.name: Pratham GN
meta.tagline: 13 years building full-stack web applications across banking, HR and media platforms — React/Redux on the front, Java Spring Boot and microservices on the back.

paragraphs: I'm a full-stack engineer with 13 years of experience across frontend, backend and automation, currently building institutional banking applications at ANZ as a full-stack developer — from requirements and development through system test support, code quality checks, deployment and CI, including automation of UI operations. Earlier roles at Viatris and Mindtree covered ASP.NET web applications, AngularJS/WebAPI analytics tools, and WCF reporting systems.

I'm looking for my next full-stack role in Bengaluru — building product end-to-end with React/Redux and Java/Spring Boot microservices, the same way I have across banking, HR and media platforms for over a decade.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
experience.summary: Institutional banking platform (Orion), built from scratch
highlights: Worked as a full stack developer on Orion, an institutional banking clients/customers platform built from scratch, from requirements through development, system test support and user access testing support
Handled data flow across multiple upstream and downstream systems with multiple stakeholders, with a focus on quality, user experience and turnaround time
Owned code scan for quality checks, deployment, continuous integration, and automation of UI operations

experience.title: Software Developer
experience.summary: HR and workforce management web applications
highlights: Built Eclearance, an ASP.NET application for HR-initiated employee clearance, routing approvals to concerned departments before final relieval

Built AMS (Attendance Management System), an ASP.NET application covering attendance marking/regularization, leave application and approval, shift assignment, and employee/report management for managers and admins
Added biometric attendance capture as a new integration into AMS

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.summary: Client: Time Inc — Consumer Marketing Analytic Systems (CMAS)
highlights: Built CircManager, a WCF reporting application generating circulation reports by magazine, time period, groups and columns

Built CLTV (Customer Lifetime Valuation) from scratch using AngularJS and WebAPI, projecting ~50 billing/renewal parameters 1, 3 and 5 years out from historical data, with scenario editing and unit test automation via Jasmine and Protractor
Worked on Listplanning, a suite of 8 interrelated applications, including migrating its database from Oracle to MS SQL Server
